description: Check VAT status (VAT White List / Biała Lista) and KRS data for a Polish company by NIP. For entities without a KRS number (sole proprietors and civil partnerships, i.e. natural persons) personal data is limited (GDPR): the address is reduced to the town (the White List does not say whether it is a business or a home address), and bank accounts to their count — check a specific account with sprawdz_rachunek. The privacy field lists what was hidden.
name: sprawdz_nip
